rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly using full name and ZIP code, identified the correct delivered order and item (IPX7 earbuds), selected the cheapest alternative earbuds (IPX4, item 1646531091), and calculated the refund accurately ($26.48). However, the agent submitted the exchange without first stating the exact change and obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation, which violates the policy requiring confirmation before any order-changing action. All other information and actions were appropriate, but the missing confirmation step causes this to fail the pass bar.
